description_short: A massive turn-based JRPG about the Phantom Thieves of Hearts, combining stylish dungeon heists, school life, Confidants and Persona fusion.
description_ar: انضم إلى اللصوص الوهميين وتسلل إلى قصور تنشأ من رغبات الفاسدين لتغيير قلوبهم. خارج العالم الغامض تعيش عامًا دراسيًا في طوكيو، وتبني Confidants، وتطوّر قدراتك، وتدمج الـPersona ضمن واحدة من أضخم تجارب الـJRPG.
nintendoNotes:
Nintendo AU confirms a 14.2 GB Switch version, Nintendo Switch 2 backward compatibility, one local and one online-supported player slot, all three play modes, Save Data Cloud, English/Japanese voice-over, and more than 40 previously released DLC items included in the Switch release.

Supplier selection supplied by user: Simplified Chinese. The western Nintendo AU listing does not include Chinese in its text-language list, so Chinese is preserved as supplier regional/SKU information.

Supplier variants: Regular / 普通版 ¥6.8 (pre-discount ¥10); Standard / 标准版 ¥65.6 (pre-discount ¥70). Converted costs: Regular 1,250 IQD; Standard 14,250 IQD. Only two supplier variants exist, so no separate DLC product types are created because the included DLC is part of the Switch base release rather than a separate supplier purchase option.

gameplayPillars.title: Plan Palace Heists
gameplayPillars.description: Plan turn-based encounters around weaknesses, Baton Pass chains, technical damage, gunfire and Persona abilities.

gameplayPillars.title: Master Turn-Based Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Explore handcrafted Palaces and Mementos, solve traversal puzzles, ambush enemies and secure routes to each Treasure.

gameplayPillars.title: Live a Year in Tokyo
gameplayPillars.description: Spend calendar time with Confidants, jobs, study and activities that improve social stats and unlock combat benefits.

gameplayPillars.title: Fuse Personas and Grow Confidants
gameplayPillars.description: Persona fusion, social stats and Confidant abilities reinforce one another, rewarding careful use of each day in the calendar.

worldSummary: Modern Tokyo forms the everyday half of the game, while the Metaverse contains Palaces shaped by corrupted desires and the sprawling Mementos dungeon. The two worlds interlock through a calendar where choices influence combat progression.

storyChapters.title: The Birth of the Phantom Thieves
storyChapters.body: The protagonist arrives in Tokyo on probation and awakens to Persona power after discovering a Palace born from a corrupt adult’s desires.

storyChapters.title: Changing Hearts Across Tokyo
storyChapters.body: The Phantom Thieves grow into a public phenomenon as they target increasingly powerful figures and face greater consequences.

storyChapters.title: Royal’s Expanded Final Arc
storyChapters.body: Royal expands the final portion of the story with new relationships, conflicts and an additional major narrative arc.

storyChapters.title: The Third Semester
storyChapters.body: Royal’s expanded third-semester storyline presents a new reality and asks the Phantom Thieves to confront difficult questions about happiness and choice.

faq.q: Does Persona 5 Royal support Simplified Chinese?
faq.a: The supplied seller option says Simplified Chinese. Nintendo AU’s western product page does not list Chinese, so the file treats this as region/SKU-dependent language information.

faq.q: Does Persona 5 Royal work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists the game as compatible with Nintendo Switch 2, but it runs as the Switch version rather than a native Switch 2 Edition.
The main game is single-player. Nintendo lists some online-supported functionality, but there is no cooperative or competitive multiplayer campaign.

faq.q: Why is there no DLC purchase type even though 40+ DLC items are listed?
faq.a: Nintendo states that the Switch release already includes more than 40 previously released DLC items. The supplier data also contains only two variants, so the storefront correctly keeps only Standard Offline and Standard Online product types.
